map.根据镜检上皮细胞/白细胞/杆菌/球菌比例，自动判定阴道清洁度等级: Automatically grades vaginal cleanliness from microscopic epithelial cells/WBC/bacilli/cocci ratios.
map.按 Nugent 或 AV 评分对阴道分泌物做分级计算，辅助报告理解；诊断与用药: Grades vaginal discharge by Nugent or AV score to aid report understanding; diagnosis and medication are decided by the gynecologist.
map.Ⅰ-Ⅱ度为正常(以乳酸杆菌和上皮细胞为主)；Ⅲ-Ⅳ度提示阴道炎(球菌和白细胞增多: Grades I-II are normal (dominated by lactobacilli and epithelial cells); Grades III-IV suggest vaginitis (increased cocci and WBC, reduced lactobacilli). Combine with pH, amine test and clue cells to judge bacterial vaginosis (BV), trichomonas or fungal infection.
map.白带常规按线索细胞/Nugent 评分判读细菌性阴道病（BV）程度。: Routine discharge is graded for bacterial vaginosis (BV) severity by clue cells/Nugent score.
map.AV 评分理解需氧菌性阴道炎。: AV score helps understand aerobic vaginitis.
map.乳酸杆菌少、线索细胞多，Nugent 7-10 分判为 BV 阳性；0-3 正常: Few lactobacilli and many clue cells, Nugent 7-10 is BV-positive; 0-3 normal, 4-6 intermediate. The tool gives the grade and advises follow-up.
map.评分高就要用药吗？: Does a high score require medication?
map.有症状或孕期需治疗，无症状中间型可观察；具体由妇科医师定。: Treat if symptomatic or pregnant; asymptomatic intermediate types can be observed; specifics are decided by the gynecologist.
map.过度冲洗可能破坏菌群加重，建议规范诊治。: Excessive douching may disrupt flora and worsen it; standard diagnosis and treatment are advised.
map.能替代妇科检查吗？: Can it replace the gynecologic exam?
map.不能，评分是辅助，诊断结合症状、pH 与镜检由医师判定。: No; the score is auxiliary; diagnosis combines symptoms, pH and microscopy and is judged by the physician.
map.阴道分泌物分级工具。按 Nugent/AV 评分计算分级，辅助报告理解；诊断与用: A vaginal-discharge grading tool. Computes the grade by Nugent/AV score to aid report understanding; diagnosis and medication are decided by the gynecologist.
